notes: g7 = 70 elements (11 code-structure, 33 data-representation, 26 functional-type-idioms). 68/70 bridged with >=1 realizes/enables edge to a specific arch element; 2 unbridged (x-macro, EBO). Honest clustering: Small Memory Software siblings + representation-choice idioms map to increase-resource-usage-efficiency; indirection-removal idioms to reduce-computational-overhead; type-level safety idioms to exception-prevention (Bass names ADTs there, ECC verbatim); C++ compile-time idioms to defer-binding's compile-time-parameterization point.
